text:
Sara: Heads up — Acme (acct: acct_9f2) can't finish free trial signup. They enter card, 3DS modal opens, after auth they get 'Authentication failed' and the card isn't saved. Promo code TRIAL50 shows applied but trial still blocked. Customer says they completed 3DS twice.

Michael: Got it. Can you paste the payment request id and any gateway error? Also which region?

Sara: From logs: gateway.event=pi_1KX9abcd error=three_d_secure_authentication_failed gateway=stripe region=eu

```
payment-service ERROR: save_card failed account=acct_9f2 request_id=req_7b3e error_code=3DS_AUTH_FAILED
stack: PaymentGateway::AuthError
```

Kyle: Looks like Stripe responded with requires_action then later payment_failed. Could be bank declined callback or a missing webhook retry. @billing-bot can you fetch recent webhooks for acct_9f2?

billing-bot: webhook.fetch acct=acct_9f2 -> events: [payment_intent.requires_action, payment_intent.payment_failed(card_declined), checkout.session.async_payment_failed]

Michael: If card was declined we should still allow the promo/trial flow for onboarding. Policy allows manual grants for cases where 3DS blocks signup. I can grant a 30-day trial and $100 credit manually after confirmation.

Beth: Product ok with manual grant on a case-by-case basis. Please add a note to the account and mark as "bypass_card_on_file" for the trial.

Sara: I'll ask the customer to try another card or complete 3DS via their mobile device (some banks redirect to mobile apps). Meanwhile please proceed with manual grant so they can start testing.

Michael: Done. Applied promo_manual_trial_30d + credit id=cr_5c8 to acct_9f2. Updated account metadata: billing_override=true; note="3DS fail, manual grant". Request id for the grant: grant_req_22f.

Sara: Customer confirmed they can access the trial now. I'll keep thread open for 24h to monitor for billing spikes. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Kyle: I'll open a follow-up ticket with Stripe support referencing pi_1KX9abcd and include webhook receipts. We should consider a transient fallback in signup to allow trial access when 3DS fails in gateway but the user verified identity by other means.

Beth: Agree — adding a small product investigation to evaluate a safe fallback and audit trail.
